mapper.select: SELECT FROM iam.tenant_entitlements WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND resource_code = #{resourceCode}
SELECT auth_revision FROM iam.tenants WHERE id = #{tenantId}
SELECT status FROM iam.tenants WHERE id = #{tenantId}

SELECT count(*) FROM iam.tenant_entitlements te JOIN iam.resource_catalog rc ON rc.code = te.resource_code WHERE te.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND te.resource_code = #{resourceCode} AND te.status = 'active' AND rc.status = 'active'
SELECT resource_code FROM iam.tenant_entitlements WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY resource_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam.tenant_entitlements(tenant_id, resource_code, status, revision, granted_at, revoked_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{resourceCode}, #{status}, 1, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'active' THEN now() END, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'revoked' THEN now() END, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_code) DO NOTHING
